newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: WestpacTrust places NZ$50 mln medium term notes.
newsitem.headline: WestpacTrust places NZ$50 mln medium term notes.

text.p: WestpacTrust, the New Zealand banking arm of Australia's Westpac, said on Monday it had placed a NZ$50 million medium term note issue of eight percent coupon bonds to domestic institutional investors, maturing on May 15, 2000.
It was priced at 61 basis points over 02/00 government bonds.
WestpacTrust said the issue was oversubscribed.
The senior ranking debt is rated AA- by Standard & Poor's and Aa3 by Moody's.
The Reserve Bank of New Zealand is the registrar and paying agent, and the notes have a minimum denomination of $10,000.
